changes.description: File|Save and File|Save As to save a file, either where it is or under another name.
A file's tab now shows whether the file has been modified.

OpenCOR now asks whether to save the files that have been modified before closing them, quitting OpenCOR, installing an update, resetting everything, reloading OpenCOR's Web app, or logging off or shutting down Windows.
A dialog that lists the current limitations of the CellDL Editor view.
A CellDL Editor view to edit CellDL files.
The ability to export a CellDL file to a COMBINE archive and to simulate it.
Switching views using the mouse wheel or a trackpad now switches only one view per gesture.
Blocking messages now show and hide without any transition, and their progress bar spans their full width.
A Changelog dialog, which lists the changes of all the versions of OpenCOR.
The update dialog now lists what has changed in the newer version of OpenCOR.
